purpose: Test an independent source of strict classes: exact reduced maximal-order binary norm elements, principal-ideal parity dependencies and strict local filtering on two fixed fibres.
arithmetic_input_policy: Equation-derived cubic, certified maximal order and bad-prime support only. Generic sections may be used to verify that the inherited strict kernel is zero, never exceptional points or their classes. High/low labels are not input to the norm enumeration.
selection: Every coprime pair -64<=m<=64, 1<=n<=64 in lexicographic order in both arms. Retain every smooth value and a digest of all exact values and remainders. Only binary-arm elements enter the new principal-relation stage, at most32 in frozen order.
gates: A smooth polynomial value is not a class relation until the full principal ideal, including the fixed norm square factor, is verified. A dependency is not a nontrivial Selmer class until strict local conditions and nonsquareness are certified. No factor-base generation or class-group upper bound is inferred.
failure: Checkpoint stages and preserve resource-limited results as UNKNOWN. No larger box, smoothness cutoff or memory retry is authorized by this protocol.
